description: Workers punch in and out from the mobile app, web, and customer-site kiosks; punches feed timesheets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every customer site depends on it at every shift change; lost punches become wage-and-hour errors for customers; 99.9% SLA; mobile and kiosk apps queue punches offline for up to 24 hours, which sets the MTD at one full shift cycle
manual_workaround: Mobile and kiosk offline queue uploads when service returns; paper sign-in sheets at customer sites entered later by managers

description: Managers build and publish schedules; workers view shifts in the app
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Workers need to know when to report; a morning outage hits early shifts; customers print schedules only as a workaround
manual_workaround: Customers export the last published schedule (PDF) and post it on site; the mobile app shows the cached schedule
dependent_people_or_facilities: Platform Engineering Lead; Customer Support Manager

description: Managers approve timesheets; the platform produces payroll export files for customers' payroll systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cut-offs: most customers run weekly or biweekly payroll with a fixed submission deadline; a missed export means late or wrong pay for workers; RPO follows BP-01 because exports are built from punches
manual_workaround: Customers pay from the prior period's hours with adjustments next cycle (customer-side decision)

description: Reminders, open-shift offers, and swap requests by push, SMS, and email
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missed reminders lead to missed shifts; swaps can be arranged by managers directly
manual_workaround: Managers call or text workers directly; in-app messages still work if only SMS or email fails

description: Ticketing, chat, and phone support for customer administrators
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers need help most during an outage; the status page carries updates if tools fail
manual_workaround: Status page updates; support phone line forwarded to managers' mobile phones

description: CI/CD builds, tests, and deploys the platform
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to ship hotfixes during an incident; source code is also cloned on engineers' laptops
manual_workaround: Manual build and deploy runbook from a clean laptop (to be written, P01 R-028)

description: Email, chat, HR, finance, and the company's own payroll
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Internal coordination during incidents; the company's own payroll runs biweekly
manual_workaround: Personal phones and the out-of-band contact list; payroll provider can repeat prior payroll
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite and HR SaaS vendors

description: New customer setup, data imports, and single sign-on configuration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Go-live dates can move by a few days without contract penalties

description: Invoicing and payments through the payment processor
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly billing cycle; cash reserves cover several weeks
manual_workaround: Invoice manually from the finance system

business_process: AI assistant (schedule summaries and shift-swap suggestions)
description: Generative summaries and ranked swap suggestions (beta, 40 customers)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Optional beta feature; core scheduling works without it; can be switched off by feature flag
manual_workaround: Turn off the feature; managers use standard swap lists
